sentences.en: It is important to note that his assertion is groundless.
sentences.zh: 需要注意的是，他的说法是没有根据的。

sentences.en: Nobody will believe his assertion that he is innocent.
sentences.zh: 没有人会相信他声称自己是无辜的说法。

sentences.en: The truth value of an assertion may be a probability value.
sentences.zh: 一个声明的真实性可能是概率值。

senses.zh: (权利等的)主张，维护；(意见等的)坚持强硬陈词；断言
